production.direction_en: A dead wolf rises from the shrine ditch with a cracked bell fused through its jaw. The air goes silent around it.
production.music_direction_en: pre: silence — the air goes silent around the wolf; no music until the battle starts | battle: bgm_boss_beast | post: sting_bell_toll (the bell stops), then bgm_ch1_ash_forest (uneasy layer)

commands.speaker: nixie_vale
commands.text: That is not a wolf. That is what the bell left wearing one.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: Front line, hold. Rear line, wait for the jaw to open.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: When it opens, strike the clapper. We only get one clean chance.
